descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S22 Real phone: the UAT script spoken in both contexts, and a task closed with the phone clock a day behind

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 Tasks dictated in pre-round ('follow up BMP', 'PT eval', 'recheck weight in two weeks') appear on the patient's task list as three open tasks, one each (the precondition the Expected Result's 'the th … (UAT TC-22 step 1; TFA-92588 AC 10) — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). … (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U5 A conditional order ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') becomes a task (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U6 A retraction ('leave glargine at 20') does not become a task (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U12 Each run records which AI ran each step: the model for task extraction (parsing.extractTasks) and for the Hospital pre-round processing, and whether the backup model was used (UAT 3.9; UAT 3.1)
  • U13 Task retention and clock: Hospital completed tasks clear at 16 h; Hospital open tasks clear 36 h after the chart was last processed; … (UAT 3.6; UAT 3.8)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given A local simulator/emulator or device build pointed at the local stack (never the store or TestFlight build, which uses the dev deployment), @roundai.test account, one patient per context

When (a) Speak the three pre-round tasks and the bedside dictation (UAT steps 1–4) with the microphone, then Save Note / Save & Extract. (b) Set the phone clock 24 h BEHIND, close 'follow up BMP' by Save & Extract, go back to the list and reopen Task Export; read the stored doneAt through a read-only local query

Then (a) Same outcome as S01/S03; the transcript holds the dictated words. (b) 'follow up BMP' is still under Finished Tasks after the list reloads, and the stored doneAt is server time ±5 min (3.8)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): (a) Tester compares with the S01/S03 checkpoints; records the speech-to-text engine (GPT-Live or Deepgram) and the task model (3.9). (b) UAT 3.8, decided on the stored value and the next list load, within minutes: on main doneAt is stamped from the device clock (useEncounterTasks.ts, useSaveAndExtract.ts) while applyLifecycle uses server Date.now() (convex/lib/lifecycle.ts:220 …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
